uncertainty: Pilot cell at the ten-path ceiling, ranked by npm 30-day downloads (2026-10-17 to 2026-11-15). Families: dns-packet with two forks (@dnsquery/dns-packet, kept as a rewrite at 4.3% shared distinct source lines, 29.8% normalised; @noelminamino/dns-packet, a fork of @dnsquery that shares 38.8% of its distinct lines with it, kept as a separate package API with the overlap recorded) and dns-message (a DataView rewrite derived from dns-packet, 0.6% shared); independent decoders dns2, native-dns-packet, hbo-dnsd (dnsd fork; the original dnsd is the excluded near-identical pair), dns-js, @gibme/dns and @portable/dns-packet. Z handling differs: hbo-dnsd and @portable/dns-packet report AD and CD only; several harnesses compress AAAA text per RFC 5952 from the library's decoded groups, and type/class names are mapped back with each package's own tables (dns-packet forks, hbo-dnsd, @gibme/dns, @portable/dns-packet via its unexported dist/codes.js). dns2's and @gibme/dns's line totals include module-load lines of their bundled client/server modules. Excluded: @leichtgewicht/dns-packet (99.6% of its lines are in @dnsquery/dns-packet, its successor), mdns-js-packet (earlier name of dns-js), dnsd, @serverless-dns/dns-parser and two native-dns-packet forks (near-identical), and the clients dns-query, native-dns, dohdec and multicast-dns. bns stays a lead without a documented message-bytes API; dnspacket-ts is below the ceiling. Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Package-level adoption metrics include non-DNS use, @portable/dns-packet was first released three weeks before the window ended, and the cell is not a definitive top ten.
selection: Ten control-verified JavaScript DNS path(s), ranked by npm downloads, 2026-10-17:2026-11-15 (30 days): dns-packet 5.6.1 (81,519,355), @dnsquery/dns-packet 6.1.1 (785,358), dns2 3.1.1 (304,498), native-dns-packet 0.1.1 (72,104), hbo-dnsd 0.9.8 (34,937), dns-js 0.3.1 (13,675), @gibme/dns 22.0.0 (1,965), @noelminamino/dns-packet 7.1.1 (754), @portable/dns-packet 0.1.0 (594), dns-message 1.1.1 (127).
